item.title: Full list of concerts at the Rady Shell in 2026
item.description: The Rady Shell, a waterfront open-air venue in San Diego, has hosted major acts since its opening in 2021 and will feature global performers such as Paul Simon, Sarah McLachlan, and "Weird Al" Yankovic in its 2026 lineup.

item.title: Rollover crash on northbound I-805 blocks lanes
item.description: A rollover crash involving a black Subaru Forester with people trapped inside has blocked all northbound lanes on Interstate 805 near North Park, according to a Sig Alert from California Highway Patrol.

item.title: San Diego athletes win Olympic medals
item.description: Elana Meyers Taylor and Kaillie Humphries, both with ties to San Diego, won gold and bronze medals respectively for Team U.S.A. at the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Games.

item.title: San Diego police warn popular “Senior Assassin” game could lead to dangerous situations
item.description: Police are not banning the game but are urging parents to speak with their teens about the risks, especially when using toy guns that resemble real firearms.

item.title: Fiery three-vehicle crash in Rancho San Diego
item.description: Three cars were engulfed in flames after a traffic accident in Rancho San Diego Sunday night.

item.title: After a week of rain, San Diego expects warmer weather and sunshine
item.description: Warmer weather is coming to San Diego this week after several rainstorms swept over the county.

item.title: Person dumped in garbage truck rescued in San Ysidro
item.description: A person inside a trash bin was rescued from a garbage truck in San Ysidro after being dumped into it, and was taken to the hospital with minor injuries.

item.title: Powerball ticket worth $1.5 million sold at Escondido gas station
item.description: A Powerball ticket worth over $1.5 million was sold at a convenience store in Escondido, California, with the next drawing scheduled for Monday, Feb. 23 and an estimated prize of $203 million.

item.title: Government shutdown causes confusion over TSA Precheck status
item.description: Travelers at San Diego International Airport were left confused after the DHS announced it would suspend TSA PreCheck lanes due to a partial government shutdown, only for the TSA to later clarify that the program remains operational.

item.title: Violence erupts in Tijuana after cartel leader killing
item.description: Tijuana residents crossing the San Ysidro border on Sunday were on edge after reports of violence in their city after a cartel leader was killed by the Mexican Army.
